title: Add editable user profile (display name) for chayan

requirements.text: Add backend support for reading and editing the signed-in user's profile so the user can edit their display name after first login.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a query method that returns the caller’s current profile (at minimum: displayName and encryptionKey) or an explicit 'not registered' result.
Backend exposes a shared method that updates only the caller’s displayName without requiring re-registering the user.
Updating displayName does not change the user’s stored encryptionKey.
Calls to update displayName for a caller who is not registered do not corrupt state (either no-op or return an error result, but must be handled safely).

requirements.text: Make user registration idempotent on the backend so that logging in multiple times does not overwrite an existing profile unintentionally.
acceptanceCriteria: If the caller already has a profile, the registration path does not overwrite the existing displayName/encryptionKey unless explicitly intended by a dedicated update method.
If the caller does not yet have a profile, registration creates it successfully.

requirements.text: Add a frontend 'Edit profile' flow that lets the signed-in user update their display name, and ensure the updated display name is shown in the header dropdown and used across the UI where the current user name is displayed.
acceptanceCriteria: The header user dropdown includes an 'Edit profile' action.
Selecting 'Edit profile' opens a dialog with an editable display name field and Save/Cancel actions (English UI text).
Saving updates the display name via the backend and updates the displayed name in the header without requiring a full page refresh.
Validation prevents saving an empty/whitespace-only display name and shows a clear error message in English.
If the backend update fails, the UI shows an error message in English and leaves the previous display name unchanged.

requirements.text: Update the frontend login/initialization behavior to load the current user profile from the backend (when available) and only generate/register a default profile when the user has no profile yet.
acceptanceCriteria: On app load after authentication, the app attempts to fetch the caller’s profile from the backend.
If a profile exists, the UI uses the stored displayName instead of regenerating a new default name.
If no profile exists, the app registers the user once with a default display name and generated encryption key material, then uses that display name in the UI.
Repeated sign-ins do not create or overwrite the profile when it already exists.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo; only add migration.mo if a state upgrade is actually required.
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose existing UI components instead.
Do not add third-party authentication providers; Internet Identity remains the only auth method.
nonGoals: Do not add avatars, profile photos, status messages, or presence/online indicators.
Do not add group chats or multi-user conversations.
Do not introduce real-time messaging (no WebSockets); keep existing polling behavior.
Do not change the client-side encryption scheme beyond what is necessary for profile editing.
